title: Upcoming Order
description: A recurring order the Business plans to place under a subscription.

id.description: Opaque identifier of this planned order, stable while it is planned. A Platform sends it to skip or unskip the order.

status.description: Well-known values: `scheduled` (the Business will place this order) and `skipped` (the Business will not place it). Platforms MUST tolerate unknown values.

expected_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time when the Business expects to place the order. Indicative: the Business owns the calendar.

line_item_ids.description: IDs of the subscription lines this order contains. Absent when it contains every line.

totals.description: Breakdown of what the order is expected to cost, with exactly one `total` entry, before taxes, fulfillment, and fees unless the Business can state them.

operations.description: Operations on this order, keyed by operation name: `skip_subscription_order` and `unskip_subscription_order`. A key that is absent means the operation does not apply to this order.
